fix: [...] of the affair concerning Ariarathes [...] into the proverb: for having [...] they became [...] to their enemies.

fix: He was to evacuate the cities and territory [...].

Λεύκιον τὸν ἀδελφόν: Lucius Manlius, brother of the consul Gnaeus Manlius (cf. Livy 38.37, 39), not Thermus's brother.
